user.title: Pair a PARAM KEY remote
user.description: A new remote starts pairing on its own. To pair one again, hold home and back for 5 seconds. When its screen says "Pair with Home Assistant", wait a few seconds and select Submit.

discovery_confirm.title: Pair a PARAM KEY remote
discovery_confirm.description: Remote {mac} is asking to pair.{again} Select Submit, then check the code on its screen.

pair.title: Check the code
pair.description: Within a few seconds the remote shows a code. Confirm only if it is **{code}**. If it shows another code, close this and hold home and back on the remote for 5 seconds to start over: someone else answered it.

error.no_remote: No remote is asking to pair yet. Check that its screen says "Pair with Home Assistant", wait a few seconds and try again.

abort.already_in_progress: This remote is already being paired.
abort.request_expired: The remote stopped asking to pair. Hold home and back on it for 5 seconds and try again.
abort.bad_key: The remote sent an invalid key. Hold home and back on it for 5 seconds and try again.
abort.no_bridge: No bridge took the reply. Check that a PARAM KEY bridge is online, with "Allow the device to perform Home Assistant actions" turned on.
abort.paired_again: The remote is paired again with a new key.

send_ir.name: Send IR code
send_ir.description: Sends an IR code from a remote's IR LED. The remote must be awake (a key press or being picked up wakes it).

remote.name: Remote
remote.description: MAC of the remote (the key event's remote), instead of entity_id.

protocol.name: Protocol
protocol.description: nec, samsung, sony, rc5, rc6, pronto or raw.

address.name: Address
address.description: Device address (nec, samsung, sony, rc5, rc6). Decimal or 0x hex.

command.name: Command
command.description: Command code (nec, samsung, sony, rc5, rc6). Decimal or 0x hex.

repeat.name: Repeats
repeat.description: Extra repeats of the code. Default 0, or 2 for Sony.

timings.name: Raw timings
timings.description: Microseconds, positive = carrier on, negative = off.

carrier.name: Carrier
carrier.description: Carrier frequency in Hz for raw timings. Default 38000.
